# Pixel Platformer

A mini platformer with player, enemies, pickups, levels, etc.

**NOTE: Add Scenes to Build Settings to load the next level when completed.**

{height=300}![screenshot](Packages/com.hutonggames.playmaker/Editor/Addons/Packages/com.hutonggames.playmaker.samples.pixel-platformer.jpg)

## Features

- Uses Input and 2d Physics to control the player.
- Sync animator parameters to player state.
- Collect pickups.
- Traps that kill the player.
- Enemies with patrol routes.
- Respawn player when killed.
- One way and falling platforms.
- Detect level cleared and load next level.
